Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the PO. Quick answers up front: you can do either portal delivery or emailed PDFs; we also support a hybrid where invoices are pushed to the portal and an email copy is sent to a designated billing contact.

Details and tradeoffs:
- Portal (recommended for recurring usage): automated push, AP reconciliation metadata (PO number, ledger tags), and a downloadable signed PDF. When enrolled, invoices appear in your portal tenancy within 24 hours of emission.
- Email PDFs: immediate email delivery to the billing address; good if your AP team doesn't want to onboard the portal.
- Hybrid: push to portal + email copy to one address or distribution list. This preserves AP workflow while giving your systems the portal metadata.

On VAT: if Acme is in the EU or using a reverse-charge mechanism, we include VAT fields on the invoice. If you have VAT registration evidence, please send it once and we will tag the account so subsequent invoices include the correct VAT note.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm billing contact(s) to receive email copies (if hybrid/email).
2) Tell us if you want portal enrollment; if yes we will send the portal invite and a short onboarding checklist.
3) If VAT evidence is needed, attach it here or forward to billing-evidence@redwood.com.

Assigning Connor to help with the portal setup if you choose that route — Connor, can you take point on enrollment?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
